text:
elaine: sketch idea: show a fallback "heatmap" (time on x, routes on y) where color density = % of requests that would fallback at current sensitivity. gives quick glance.

hiro: heatmap is neat. can we layer in "budget" lines so you see when fallback would exceed budgeted degraded-requests for a route?

ben: budget lines make sense. storage/telemetry note: to compute realtime preview we need rolling window histograms per route. cost hit but we can downsample.

elaine: downsample ok if we surface sample rate. operators should know preview is approximate. tiny tooltip: "Preview uses sampled telemetry (1-5%) unless you enable full backfill."

qa-bot: qa-bot: reminder: any preview mode must not trigger downstream alerts. label sim=true on preview events.

hiro: UX detail: clicking a heatmap cell should open a mini-panel showing example breadcrumb(s) and a sampled trace link. keep breadcrumbs compact.

ben: breadcrumb example we discussed: ```json
{"r":"latency","s":0.73,"f":"fallback-lite","aid":"c4f0"}
```

elaine: love the compact form. also add an operator annotation feature: flag a heatmap cell with a note that persists for 7d. useful during incidents.

hiro: RBAC: only on-call+platform-admins can write annotations or trigger escape-hatch. others get view-only.

ben: escape-hatch behavior: immediate rollback to safe defaults for all routes or per-route? prefer per-route + a global option. global should require 2FA/confirmation.

elaine: agree per-route by default. global needs stricter gating. UI: big red "Abort all fallbacks" with a small confirm drawer for global.

qa-bot: qa-bot: add automated verification step when escape-hatch executed in prod: run smoke-checks and post results to channel.

ops-bot: deploybot: scheduled canary of heatmap-preview on staging at 02:30 UTC — will tag preview events with sim=true :rocket:

hiro: telemetry backfill question: if operator raises sensitivity after hours, preview should show both "last 1h" and "historical 30d" estimates so you can see typical vs recent. important for noisy diurnal patterns.

ben: storage retention thought: compact breadcrumbs 365d, full traces 14d, annotations 90d. make defaults overrideable per-org.

elaine: need to show estimated additional storage/cost on the panel when you toggle longer retention. quick calc: "Estimated extra storage: ~24GB/month for 5k QPS at 100B crumbs". include link to cost-calculator.

hiro: telemetry accuracy: we should expose a confidence band on the heatmap cells (eg +/- 3%) based on sample rate. helps operators trust preview.

ben: implementation note: compute heatmap from sidecar aggregator streaming histograms to preview service; preview service runs sim against histogram windows. avoids touching production request path.

elaine: Action items: 1) @ben build prototype aggregator + sample preview API. 2) @hiro mock heatmap + annotation UX (Figma). 3) @elaine draft RBAC & escape-hatch flow. 4) @qa-bot define verification steps and sim tagging.

ben: will start the aggregator branch and post PR with sample data format.

ops-bot: deploybot: canary run will emit a small batch of preview events to staging logs for 24h.

elaine: thanks team. if staging looks good we'll schedule a short 1h prod dry-run in a low-traffic window. :+1:
